title: Frobenius Gram matrix and dual construction in $H_3(q)$
html:
Proposition. Frobenius Gram matrix and dual construction in H_3(q)

Gram matrix (symbolic in q)

Proposition (symbolic entries, with the z^3 substitution still to be propagated). The 6 \times 6 Gram matrix G_{ij} = \mathrm{tr}_M(b_i \cdot b_j) over the NF basis \{\gamma, \sigma_0, \sigma_1, L_+, L_-, e^-\} has the structural form below. The entries containing z^3 or higher z^k powers from \mathrm{tr}_M(e^-) are written using the naive length rule \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w) = z^{\ell(w)}, which fails on adjacent triples; the correction z^3 \mapsto hz^2 + z has still to be propagated through them:

  G
  =
  \begin{pmatrix}
    1     & z     & z     & z^2     & z^2     & z^3 \\
    z     & hz+1  & z^2   & hz^2+z  & z^3  & g_{15} \\
    z     & z^2   & hz+1  & z^3  & hz^2+z  & g_{15} \\
    z^2   & hz^2+z & z^3 & g_{15} & g_{34} & g_{35} \\
    z^2   & z^3 & hz^2+z & g_{34} & g_{15} & g_{35} \\
    z^3 & g_{15} & g_{15} & g_{35} & g_{35} & g_{55}
  \end{pmatrix}

where (subject to the same uncorrected z^3 entries):

  • g_{15} = hz^3 + z^2 (from \sigma_0 \cdot e^- = he^- + L_-)
  • g_{34} = hz^3 + hz + 1 (from L_+ \cdot L_- = he^- + h\sigma_0 + \gamma)
  • g_{35} = h^2z^3 + 2hz^2 + z (from L_+ \cdot e^- = h^2e^- + hL_+ + hL_- + \sigma_1)
  • g_{55} = (h^3+h)z^3 + 2h^2z^2 + 2hz + 1 (from e^- \cdot e^- = (h^3+h)e^- + h^2L_+ + h^2L_- + h\sigma_1 + h\sigma_0 + \gamma)

The matrix is symmetric (G_{ij} = G_{ji}, by cyclicity of the Markov trace). It is degenerate: under the production convention D the (1^3) Wedderburn block carries y_{(1^3)} = 0 symbolically, so that block lies in the radical of the form and \det G = 0 identically — measured 2.89\times10^{-51} at 50 dps (GramSignature.lean), against \det G = -0.18920521914403668 under the excised convention C. G^{-1} does not exist. Any statement about the signature must name its pairing. On the bilinear pairing \mathrm{tr}_M(b_i b_j) that this table builds, the spectrum at q_0 is (-0.75270211,\ 0,\ +0.75270211^{\times 3},\ +4.23033923) under D and (-0.85506726,\ +0.10179667,\ +0.85506726^{\times 3},\ +3.47694980) under C. On the star pairing \mathrm{tr}_M(b_i b_j^*) — the correct one, since the Hecke star is T_w^* = T_{w^{-1}}, which swaps L_+ \leftrightarrow L_- on this basis — the form is positive: (6,0,0) under C, (5,0,1) under D. The earlier reading of this block as indefinite or Lorentzian is withdrawn (commit 748ba9b1); it was an artefact of quoting the bilinear pairing without saying so. What survives both pairings is the single null direction under D.

Digit corrected 2026-09-05 (qou-i229, probe the_gram_block_publishes_a_D_eigenvalue_no_pin_produces_probe.py, 6/6). The largest D eigenvalue read +4.23033920. This block's own declared witness computes 4.230339225030225 at the proton pin — which rounds to 4.2303392\mathbf{3}, five half-ulps away at the published precision. It is a transcription error rather than a pin difference: recomputing the whole 6 \times 6 from this block's symbolic entries gives 4.2303392\mathbf{3} at the proton pin and 4.2303394\mathbf{0} at the muon and retired pins, and no registered q_0 produces 4.23033920. The other five D entries are correct at the proton pin and unchanged.

The C column is untouched and remains unverified against an independent computation — convention C is excised, so none exists. It does pass the one check its own numbers permit: the six published C eigenvalues multiply to -0.18920521\underline{5} against the published \det G = -0.18920521\underline{9}144, a 2.0 \times 10^{-8} agreement, which is what six figures rounded to 8 decimals should give. That is internal consistency, not verification.

The Markov-trace computation of the NF basis elements, the operator-identification via the Frobenius dual, and the annihilation identity e^- \cdot e^+ = \gamma are collected in the Frobenius Gram-matrix context.
